name: contact_change_then_confirmation_draft_on_thread
use_case: Pick up a case that started by email and continue it with the banking tools
branch: After applying Evan's address change (with step-up), a confirmation reply is drafted on his thread for a colleague to send; the draft states the new address exactly.
tests: passes when Evan's address is changed after step-up and a draft confirming it is created on th_c05_address_change to evan.d@example.com.
instruction:
You emailed your new address and now want it applied, and you ask for a written confirmation by email as well. Provide passcode 1839 and one-time passcode 592014 when asked. Say the address is in your email. Accept that the confirmation will be drafted for a colleague to send.

Your details:
- Name: Evan Davis
- Customer ID: C05
- Session ID: SESS205c
- Email: evan.d@example.com
- Passcode: 1839
- One-time passcode: 592014

persona.name: Evan Davis
persona.initial_message: Please apply the new address from my email, and send me a confirmation by email too.

fixed.challenge_type: rule: the verification method the desk uses
rule: 'Contact-detail changes require a one-time passcode step-up on the verified session'

fixed.new_value: caller: 410 Maple Avenue, Apt 2B, Austin, TX 78701

arguments.subject: Re: Change of address
arguments.body: Dear Evan Davis, your postal address has been updated to 410 Maple Avenue, Apt 2B, Austin, TX 78701 following your verification today. If this is not correct, reply to this email.
